economy._comment: Weekly income = population x tax_rate x tax_revenue_per_capita_weekly x productivity(morale) + trade_income (nations.json) x productivity. Tax policy sets the rate and a weekly civil-morale drift. Bankrupt (treasury <= 0): civil and military morale fall every week and research halts.

intel._comment: Chance a report is flatly wrong = base x (1 - accuracy) x 2, unless the spec overrides misinformation_chance.

unit_recon._comment: Accuracy of enemy-unit estimates on the map, re-rolled once per week.

reports.status_sender: Ministry of the Treasury — Automated Ledger

map._comment: War Room. Friendly = player nation; everyone else is hostile. SCALE: miles_per_cell = miles per map row (one grid step); column_scale: a column is half as far as a row (terminal characters are twice as tall as wide), so a column is 5 miles. transport_cost: multiplier on a step along rail/road/destroyed rail (terrain is ignored there). obstacle_cost: extra multiplier for crossing trench lines. ghost_weeks: how long a lost contact stays plotted. debug_reveal_all: show every enemy (or run main.py --reveal). Destroyed rail and road (no-man's-land, or sabotaged: see scorched_earth) give no movement or supply bonus until Combat Engineers repair them.

logistics._comment: Supply is traced each week along the cheapest path (movement costs: roads/rail are cheap) from a source: a friendly settlement (source_features; each type reaches source_range_by_type, towns only a short way), an unblockaded port, or the nation's home map edge. An in-supply HQ extends the net by hq_range. Paths cannot pass THROUGH enemy zones of control (cells within zoc_radius of an enemy land unit). SUPPLIED: within range. OVEREXTENDED: path exists but too long. ISOLATED: no path. In territory owned by another nation, supply cannot use roads/rail and pays terrain cost x hostile_territory_factor. Warships are supplied from friendly unblockaded harbours instead (config naval.supply_range).

resupply._comment: Supplied units draw from the national stockpile each week toward their establishment (template loadout x strength share). Per-week cap = establishment x (consumable_max - (consumable_max - consumable_min) x reach) for ammunition/consumables, x heavy_rate for weapons and vehicles. Engaged units are served first. Replacements: supplied units out of combat regain replacement_rate of establishment per week from the manpower pool.

production._comment: Factories assigned to a line produce batch*(7/factory_days)*efficiency units per week each, limited by raw resource inputs. A new line starts at start_efficiency and gains efficiency_gain per week up to 1.0. Each assigned factory costs upkeep_per_factory per week (ledger).

combat._comment: Weekly combat in every battle. Damage = firepower x stance.attack x morale factor x supply factor x air support x weather x noise, plus fire support from artillery and warships; casualties = damage x casualty_factor / (terrain defense x fortification x stance.defense). fortification applies within fort_range columns of the unit's own trench line; urban_fortification in urban terrain or within 1 row of a town or city. ARTILLERY (templates with `support`) that is not itself in contact fires for the nearest friendly battle within artillery_support_range rows of an engaged friendly formation: its firepower x artillery_support_multiplier is added to that side and it takes no casualties. Every nation's military morale moves with its battles (victory +, defeat -).

recruitment._comment: Raising a formation costs its template recruit_cost (CR) and manpower up front, then takes training_weeks. It musters at the capital (or nations.json muster_point) with full manpower, initial_morale, and initial_issue of its establishment drawn from the national stockpile; logistics fills the rest. Cancelling refunds all manpower and cancel_refund of the cost.

research._comment: One project at a time per nation; progress is kept if you switch. No progress while bankrupt.

naval._comment: Warships move only on open water. SUPPLY: within supply_range (sea movement cost) of a friendly, unblockaded harbour. BLOCKADE: an enemy port is closed while a warship on a BLOCKADE mission lies within blockade_range rows of it and no warship of the port's owner is within the same range (a contested blockade fails): the port stops supplying and its overseas trade is lost. BOMBARD: a warship on a BOMBARD mission, not itself in contact, adds its guns' soft_attack x bombard_multiplier to the nearest friendly land battle within bombard_range rows. NAVAL BATTLE: when hostile fleets make contact, each side's hard_attack x damage_per_attack damages enemy hulls (spread by hull share); non-ASW fire against submarines is x non_asw_vs_submarine. A fleet that loses its nerve (morale < retire_morale) breaks off toward its harbour. in_port_range: rows from a friendly harbour that count as 'in port' (no storm damage).

air._comment: Air wings are abstract (not on the map). Each is assigned to a sector (a map region) or held at base. Effective air power = aircraft x fuel ratio x weather air factor. SUPERIORITY: our power >= superiority_ratio x theirs (and > 0); DENIED: the reverse; CONTESTED otherwise. Where both sides fly, each loses aircraft = enemy power x attrition_rate x noise. Every assigned wing burns patrol_fuel_per_aircraft aviation_fuel a week; over a sector with a friendly land battle it also flies support: support_fuel_per_aircraft fuel and bombs_per_aircraft bombs each. A land battle in a sector where a side holds SUPERIORITY gives that side attack_bonus firepower (attack_bonus_no_bombs if the bombs ran out). Wings refill up to replacements_per_week aircraft from the national stockpile.

command._comment: Chain of command (data/commanders.json for traits). Orders the player gives (a stance change, a move order) are acknowledged at the start of the next week: a commander may REFUSE. Fire support = a friendly artillery formation within combat.artillery_support_range, a friendly warship on BOMBARD within naval.bombard_range, or a friendly air wing flying over the sector.

electronic_warfare._comment: Jamming zones: circles of `radius` rows. Every friendly LAND formation inside is cut off from the terminal: it vanishes from the Order of Battle, its map symbol becomes [?] at its last reported position, it cannot be given orders and its own sightings stop reaching the staff. It keeps fighting and following its last orders. The Vosk AI jams (ai.json ew); natural interference (random_chance per week, random_radius rows around one formation) blacks out for random_weeks.

scorched_earth._comment: A formation that ROUTS (rout_chance) or falls back in WITHDRAW stance (withdraw_chance per week) may blow up railways and roads behind it: cells (min..max) of rail/road within radius rows of where it stood become destroyed_rail / destroyed_road (no movement or supply bonus).

engineering._comment: Combat Engineers (template role 'engineer') holding position in supply repair repair_per_week destroyed cells (nearest first) within repair_range rows each week.

victory._comment: VICTORY: ENEMY CAPITULATION when (a) Kestrian land forces hold the enemy capital (a formation within occupation_radius rows of it and no enemy land formation as close) for occupation_weeks consecutive weeks, or (b) the enemy is bankrupt (treasury <= 0) and its military morale has fallen to collapse_military_morale.
